title: feat(advisory-convergence): explain why sameHeadReroll.eligible is false in report mode
body:
## Background

`idd-advisory-convergence`'s report mode reports
`sameHeadReroll.eligible: false` with nothing in the output explaining
why, so an agent cannot self-diagnose a stuck AW6 reroll without
re-deriving the eligibility rule by hand from the instructions.

In `src/scripts/advisory-convergence.mts`, eligibility is a conjunction
of six conditions:

```ts
const sameHeadRerollEligible =
  !scopeNotApplicable &&
  !pending &&
  threadClause.satisfied &&
  dispositionEvidence.missingRegularCommentCount === 0 &&
  review.itemCount !== null &&
  review.itemCount > 0;
```

The emitted `sameHeadReroll` object carries only `eligible`, `count`,
`cap`, `exhausted`, `inFlight`, and `shouldRequest`. The report's
top-level `reasons` array is populated for convergence and waiver
outcomes only, and `dispositionEvidence` — whose
`missingRegularCommentCount` is one of the six terms — appears nowhere
in the returned object. `--help` offers no `--verbose` or `--debug`
flag to ask for more.

**Why this costs real time.** The reported instance had the primary
bot's review on current HEAD carrying `itemCount: 1` while every
visible GraphQL review thread was already `isResolved: true`. The
actual cause was a "Comments suppressed due to low confidence" item
embedded in the review's top-level **body text** rather than posted as
a review thread: it contributes to `itemCount` but is invisible to any
`reviewThreads` query, so it can never be resolved the normal way. That
root cause was found only by reading the raw review body. Nothing in
the CLI output pointed there, and the loop is autonomous — a phase that
cannot explain its own verdict is a phase that stalls or escalates
needlessly.

`docs/idd-helper-scripts.md`'s AW6 documentation already states that
`eligible` depends in part on
`dispositionEvidence.missingRegularCommentCount === 0`, so the field
the operator needs is documented as load-bearing while never being
emitted.

## Proposed change

1. Add an `ineligibleReasons` array to the `sameHeadReroll` object: one
   short, stable machine-readable token per failing term, empty when
   `eligible` is true. Derive it from the same six terms the
   conjunction already evaluates, so the array and the boolean cannot
   disagree — compute the terms once and build both from that result.
2. Emit the eligibility-relevant `dispositionEvidence` counters
   (at minimum `missingRegularCommentCount`) on the report object, so
   the numeric input is visible and not only its pass/fail verdict.
3. When the failing term is `review.itemCount > 0` while every visible
   thread is resolved, make the reason token or its accompanying text
   point at the review body as the place to look — this is the
   observed shape of a suppressed low-confidence item, and it is not
   otherwise discoverable from any thread query.
4. Update `schemas/advisory-convergence.schema.json` and its fixtures
   under `fixtures/schemas/` for the new fields.
5. Update `docs/idd-helper-scripts.md`'s AW6 section (and its
   `idd-template/` mirror) to document the new fields.
6. Add tests asserting that `ineligibleReasons` is empty exactly when
   `eligible` is true, and that each of the six terms produces its own
   token when it is the failing one.
7. Run `pnpm run build` so the generated `scripts/*.mjs` copies match.

Keeping `eligible` itself unchanged is deliberate: this issue makes the
existing verdict explicable, and does not alter which PRs qualify for a
same-HEAD reroll.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `sameHeadReroll.ineligibleReasons` is present in report-mode
      output, is empty exactly when `sameHeadReroll.eligible` is true,
      and names each failing term when it is not.
- [ ] The report object exposes the `dispositionEvidence` counters
      that feed the eligibility conjunction.
- [ ] `schemas/advisory-convergence.schema.json` and the
      `fixtures/schemas/advisory-convergence.*.json` fixtures cover
      the new fields, and `node --test tests/*.test.mts` passes.
- [ ] Tests fail if a term is added to the eligibility conjunction
      without a corresponding reason token.
- [ ] `docs/idd-helper-scripts.md` and its `idd-template/` mirror
      document the new fields; `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check`
      passes.
- [ ] `pnpm run build:check` and `pnpm run lint` pass.

Refs: reported from an adopter repository stuck on an
`eligible: false` verdict whose root cause was a suppressed
low-confidence item in the review body.
